titleEn: Maximum Product of the Length of Two Palindromic Subsequences
title: 两个回文子序列长度的最大乘积
summary: 从字符串选两个不相交的非空回文子序列，最大化它们长度乘积。
insight: 字符串长度最多十二，可用掩码表示子序列。预先判断每个掩码按原顺序组成的字符串是否回文并记录长度，再枚举互不相交的两个回文掩码。
pitfalls: 两个子序列不能共享下标

solutions.title: 回文子集掩码枚举
solutions.idea: 穷举所有下标子集并组合互斥回文。
steps: 对 mask 双指针检查其选中字符序列是否回文，记录 bitCount 或零

code.java: class Solution { private boolean palindrome(String s,int mask){int[] indices=new int[s.length()];int size=0;for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++)if((mask&(1<<i))!=0)indices[size++]=i;for(int left=0,right=size-1;left<right;left++,right--)if(s.charAt(indices[left])!=s.charAt(indices[right]))return false;return true;}public int maxProduct(String s){int total=1<<s.length();int[] length=new int[total];for(int mask=1;mask<total;mask++)if(palindrome(s,mask))length[mask]=Integer.bitCount(mask);int answer=0;for(int first=1;first<total;first++)for(int second=first+1;second<total;second++)if((first&second)==0)answer=Math.max(answer,length[first]*length[second]);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun palindrome(s:String,mask:Int):Boolean{val indices=s.indices.filter{mask and (1 shl it)!=0};var left=0;var right=indices.lastIndex;while(left<right)if(s[indices[left++]]!=s[indices[right--]])return false;return true};fun maxProduct(s:String):Int{val total=1 shl s.length;val length=IntArray(total);for(mask in 1 until total)if(palindrome(s,mask))length[mask]=Integer.bitCount(mask);var answer=0;for(first in 1 until total)for(second in first+1 until total)if(first and second==0)answer=maxOf(answer,length[first]*length[second]);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool palindrome(string& s,int mask){string value;for(int i=0;i<(int)s.size();++i)if(mask&(1<<i))value+=s[i];return equal(value.begin(),value.begin()+value.size()/2,value.rbegin());}public: int maxProduct(string s){int total=1<<s.size();vector<int> length(total);for(int mask=1;mask<total;++mask)if(palindrome(s,mask))length[mask]=__builtin_popcount((unsigned)mask);int answer=0;for(int first=1;first<total;++first)for(int second=first+1;second<total;++second)if(!(first&second))answer=max(answer,length[first]*length[second]);return answer;} };
